open_points.subject: _build_mapping
open_points.text: rooms and pointers whose project_id is a picked project_id
open_points.other_text: records of projects not picked, or naming a project the file does not hold, MUST take no part in any check, conflict, duplicate count or list of the mapping.
open_points.question: For a pick whose project_id is absent from the file, must rooms and pointers naming that id be brought in or excluded?

open_points.subject: _parse_export
open_points.text: _parse_export: [SCHEMA_CONSTRAINT] MUST answer an ExportParsed whose ExportFile keeps every record of each array in file order, each with its position in its array counted from zero and every field named by = models.ExportProject, = models.ExportRoom or = models.ExportPointer as the member of that name gives it, unchanged text or None when the member is absent or null; members of other names are ignored.
open_points.other_text: - ExportProject fields (exact, no others exist): address: str | None, archived_at: str | None, created_at: str | None, customer_ref: str | None, name: str | None, position: int, project_id: str | None, status: str | None, updated_at: str | None
open_points.question: Must position be synthesized as the zero-based integer, or copied from the JSON member unchanged as text or None? The same conflict also applies to ExportRoom.position and ExportPointer.position.

open_points.subject: _file_digest and confirm_import
open_points.text: _file_digest: [PROVENANCE] MUST be the only source of a file digest in this module: every digest the module answers or compares is computed by it over the bytes in hand, never taken from a caller.
open_points.other_text: confirm_import: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST then answer, alone and at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_LIFECYCLE constant names with the REFUSED member of = models.RefusalCode, one failure of the FILE_NOT_KEPT member of = models.RefusalKind with an empty path when kept is None, when its upload_number is not bound_upload_number, or when _file_digest of its content is not bound_digest; equal bytes of another upload never stand in for the bound one.
open_points.question: May confirm_import compare against the caller-supplied bound_digest, or must every compared digest be computed locally from bytes?

open_points.subject: _file_digest and confirm_import
open_points.text: _file_digest: [PROVENANCE] MUST be the only source of a file digest in this module: every digest the module answers or compares is computed by it over the bytes in hand, never taken from a caller.
open_points.other_text: confirm_import: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer an ImportConfirmed holding the bound digest, one ImportedProjectResult per written project in project_id order with the values it was written with, and one MadeCustomer per Customer made in v1 value order with the customer_ref make_imported_customer gave it.
open_points.question: Must ImportConfirmed.file_digest contain the caller-supplied bound digest or a digest freshly computed by _file_digest?

open_points.subject: _file_digest and record_migration_closure
open_points.text: _file_digest: [PROVENANCE] MUST be the only source of a file digest in this module: every digest the module answers or compares is computed by it over the bytes in hand, never taken from a caller.
open_points.other_text: record_migration_closure: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST make one MigrationClosure with file_digest and confirmation_id as given, accepted_at the given instant and principal an ActingPrincipal of the OWNER member of = models.PrincipalKind with no service and no session_id, MUST write it through transaction.insert_migration_closure and MUST answer it.
open_points.question: May record_migration_closure answer a caller-supplied file_digest despite having no file bytes, or must its contract provide bytes so _file_digest can compute it?

open_points.subject: confirm_import
open_points.text: confirm_import: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST build every imported record it hands to a writing module from the file's record of it, with instants read as timezone-aware UTC datetimes, the project's updated_at as last_changed_at, a room's created_at as added_at and a pointer's created_at as published_at, statuses and services as members of their enumerations and the version as a whole number.
open_points.other_text: confirm_import: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST leave every write to the record's own module: it MUST NOT write a record itself, MUST NOT open, commit or roll back a transaction, MUST NOT write the migration closure, and MUST NOT apply any value other than those choices carries.
open_points.question: May confirm_import apply values obtained from the export file and the instant argument, or must every applied value come from choices?

open_points.subject: read_import_mapping
open_points.text: read_import_mapping: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST first ask transaction.load_migration_closure and, when it answers a closure, MUST answer at once a Refusal whose code is the REFUSED member of = models.RefusalCode, whose stage is the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_LIFECYCLE constant and whose failures are one RefusalFailure of the IMPORT_CLOSED member of = models.RefusalKind with an empty path, reading no byte of body, parsing nothing and making no other check.
open_points.other_text: read_import_mapping: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise ValueError, before reading anything, when the inputs its mode needs are not given: body in the UPLOAD member of = models.ImportMode, or choices in the MAPPING member; this is a wiring fault and never an answer to the owner.
open_points.question: When a required mode input is absent, must the function raise ValueError before loading the closure, or must it load the closure first and return IMPORT_CLOSED when one exists?

open_points.subject: read_import_mapping
open_points.text: read_import_mapping: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise ValueError, before reading anything, when the inputs its mode needs are not given: body in the UPLOAD member of = models.ImportMode, or choices in the MAPPING member; this is a wiring fault and never an answer to the owner.
open_points.other_text: read_import_mapping: [VALIDATION_ERROR] In the MAPPING member of = models.ImportMode it MUST, after the closure and before any other check, answer a Refusal whose code is the REFUSED member of = models.RefusalCode, whose stage is the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_LIFECYCLE constant and whose failures are one RefusalFailure of the FILE_NOT_KEPT member of = models.RefusalKind with an empty path when kept_content is None, parsing nothing.
open_points.question: In MAPPING mode when both choices and kept_content are absent, must the function raise ValueError for choices or return FILE_NOT_KEPT before that check?
